verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists Chat as a native product alongside Sprints, tasks and Docs. A community user confirms ClickUp has real-time chat, and the API docs reference Chat views that hold comments, so engineers can talk with teammates inside the same tool they plan work in. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of chat features (channels, DMs, threads, linking messages to tasks), and hands-on detail of how chat works alongside sprint planning.
